name: Brightfield
short: Contrast from absorption of transmitted light

name: Darkfield
short: Only scattered light reaches the objective

name: Phase contrast
short: Zernike phase ring turns phase shifts into intensity

name: Differential interference contrast
short: Nomarski prisms image optical path gradients

name: Polarized light
short: Birefringence between crossed polarizers

name: Stereo microscopy
short: Two light paths give a 3D view at low magnification

name: Widefield fluorescence
short: Epi-illumination of the whole field with filter cubes

name: TIRF
short: Evanescent wave excites ~100 nm above the coverslip

name: HILO / oblique
short: Highly inclined thin beam for reduced background

name: Point-scanning confocal
short: Pinhole rejects out-of-focus light

name: Spinning-disk confocal
short: Thousands of pinholes in parallel for fast live imaging

name: Image scanning (Airyscan, ISM)
short: Detector array behind the pinhole gains ~1.7x resolution

name: Multiphoton
short: Nonlinear excitation only at the focus, deep in tissue

name: Light-sheet (SPIM)
short: A thin sheet of light illuminates only the focal plane

name: Lattice light-sheet
short: Optical lattices make thin, long, gentle sheets

name: Oblique-plane (OPM, SCAPE)
short: Light-sheet through a single objective

name: Structured illumination (SIM)
short: Moire fringes bring high frequencies into the passband

name: STED
short: A doughnut depletion beam shrinks the effective PSF

name: Single-molecule localization (PALM, STORM)
short: Sparse blinking molecules localized to nanometres

name: DNA-PAINT
short: Transient DNA hybridization produces the blinking

name: MINFLUX / MINSTED
short: Localization with a patterned beam's intensity minimum

name: Fluctuation (SOFI, SRRF)
short: Statistics of intensity fluctuations sharpen images

name: Expansion microscopy
short: Physically swell the sample in a hydrogel

name: FLIM
short: Image the fluorescence lifetime, not just intensity

name: FRET
short: Energy transfer reports distances of 1-10 nm

name: FCS / FCCS
short: Fluctuations in a tiny volume give concentration and diffusion

name: FRAP / photoactivation
short: Bleach or activate a region and watch the recovery

name: Single-particle tracking
short: Trajectories of single molecules give diffusion and binding

name: Spectral imaging and unmixing
short: Separate overlapping fluorophores by their spectra

name: Raman
short: Inelastic scattering reveals molecular vibrations

name: CARS / SRS
short: Coherent Raman for fast chemical imaging

name: Harmonic generation (SHG, THG)
short: Non-centrosymmetric structures double the frequency

name: Quantitative phase and holotomography
short: Measure optical path length, and refractive index in 3D

name: Interferometric scattering (iSCAT)
short: Interference detects single unlabelled proteins

name: Optical coherence tomography
short: Low-coherence interferometry images depth

name: Photoacoustic
short: Light absorbed, sound detected

name: Transmission EM (incl. STEM)
short: Electrons through thin sections at sub-nanometre resolution

name: Scanning EM
short: Surface imaging with secondary and backscattered electrons

name: Cryo-EM (single particle)
short: Averaging thousands of frozen particles to atomic resolution

name: Cryo-electron tomography
short: Tilt series of frozen cells reconstructed in 3D

name: Volume EM (FIB-SEM, SBF-SEM)
short: Serial milling or cutting and imaging for 3D ultrastructure

name: Atomic force microscopy
short: A sharp tip feels the surface

name: Scanning tunnelling microscopy (STM)
short: A tunnelling current between a sharp tip and a conductor maps surfaces atom by atom

name: X-ray microscopy and micro-CT
short: Penetrating X-rays for 3D imaging

name: Correlative light and EM
short: Fluorescence finds it, EM resolves it

name: High-content screening
short: Automated imaging of multiwell plates

name: Whole-slide scanning
short: Digital pathology at gigapixel scale

name: Intravital and in vivo
short: Imaging inside living animals

name: Miniscopes and mesoscopes
short: Head-mounted and large-field brain imaging

name: Adaptive optics
short: Deformable mirrors correct sample aberrations

name: Light-field
short: Microlens arrays capture a volume in one snapshot

name: Open hardware
short: Build-it-yourself and open-source microscopes
